verdict.rationale: The official docs list a dedicated "Migration from Vue 2" guide, which covers the move between the incompatible Vue 2 and Vue 3 major versions. A community comment praises how Vue redesigned its internals and public API while keeping users happy, which loosely supports a well-handled transition. The evidence is only a link title, though, so the guide's depth and coverage cannot be confirmed. Missing for 10: the guide's actual content (breaking-change coverage, step-by-step instructions, migration tooling) and independent hands-on reports of developers using it.
